# A flint spark: a stretched icosahedron 0.14 x 0.36 m pointing -Y (its flight), a hot tip (unlit).
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Spark --base-color 1.0000 0.5373 0.2000 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.5373 0.2000
material new Core --base-color 1.0000 0.6824 0.4392 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.6824 0.4392
add mesh ico-sphere --name Spark --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.07 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 2.6 1
apply --scale
material assign Spark
mode edit
select face where "pos.y < -0.08"
material assign Core
mode object
export spark.glb
